title: Account Security Best Practices
content: To keep your account secure: (1) Use a strong, unique password with at least 12 characters, mixing uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols. (2) Enable two-factor authentication from Account Settings > Security. (3) Never share your password or API keys with anyone, including support staff. (4) Regularly review login activity in Account Settings > Security > Login History. (5) Revoke any unrecognized API keys immediately. (6) Log out of shared or public computers after use. (7) Keep your recovery email and phone number up to date.

title: Recognizing and Reporting Phishing
content: Phishing attempts try to steal your credentials by impersonating us. Signs of phishing: emails with misspelled domain names, urgent requests for your password, links that do not match platform.com. We will NEVER ask for your password via email or chat. If you receive a suspicious email claiming to be from us: (1) Do not click any links. (2) Forward the email to security@platform.com. (3) Delete the original email. If you entered your credentials on a fake site, reset your password immediately and enable 2FA.

title: API Key Security
content: API keys provide programmatic access to your account. Best practices: (1) Never commit API keys to public code repositories. (2) Use environment variables to store keys in applications. (3) Create separate keys for different applications — do not share a single key. (4) Set minimal permissions when creating keys. (5) Rotate keys regularly and immediately if you suspect compromise. (6) Delete unused keys from Account Settings > API Keys. If a key is exposed, revoke it immediately and create a new one.
